central_bank: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) — finding against its Central Mint
category: official censure (糾正) over the handling of a staff bullying complaint at the central bank's mint
people: an employee identified on the page only as 'A 君' (Mr/Ms A); the Central Mint (中央造幣廠) and the Central Bank as the responding agency
summary: The Control Yuan's Finance and Economic Committee issued a corrective measure (糾正案), case number 114財正0002, against the Central Mint — the Central Bank of the Republic of China's coin-minting works — over its handling of a workplace bullying complaint by an employee the document identifies only as 'A 君'. In its closure table the Central Bank states that the Mint revised and updated its own plan for preventing unlawful infringement in the performance of duties in May 2025 and planned related training in August 2025, and that, taking the case as a whole, the Mint's handling of and response to A's bullying complaint left room for strengthening; the Bank undertook to require the Mint to build an objective and neutral third-party investigation mechanism with outside professionals taking part. The Committee resolved at its 59th meeting of the 6th Council to close the corrective-measure case and place it on file.
source_title: 監察院財政及經濟委員會糾正案結案情形一覽表 (Control Yuan, Finance and Economic Committee, table of closed corrective-measure cases), case 114財正0002
quote: 中央造幣廠對於 A 君職場霸凌申訴案件之處理及應對
detail: DATE PROVENANCE: the page carries dates only in Republic of China era form — '114 年 5 月' and '同年 8 月' for the Mint's plan revision and training, and '114.06.04 第 6 屆第 59 次會議決議' for the closure resolution. Converted to the Gregorian calendar by adding 1911, these are May 2025, August 2025 and 4 June 2025; the conversion is mine and the page itself prints no Gregorian year. CATEGORY CAVEAT for the curator: a Control Yuan 糾正 is a formal finding of administrative fault against the audited agency, and the subject here is the central bank's own mint rather than the bank as detector, but the conduct is maladministration of a bullying complaint and not financial corruption, so a curator may prefer to move it to the removals-and-pressure row or to leave it uncounted. It is nevertheless a genuinely second episode for Taiwan: the map's existing record is the 2019 procurement complaint about the Central Engraving and Printing Plant, a different subsidiary, a different year and different conduct.
